Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps to keep momentum toward a pilot:

- Data constraints: tokens contain masked PHI-like customer IDs; no raw payment card data will be sent.
- Success criteria: end-to-end inference perf under load + integration with your staging S3 and KMS.

2) Immediate blockers to pilot
- Exec alignment: your VP Eng / CTO want a 20–30 min handshake to align scope and SLAs.
- Procurement: rough SOW and procurement path to get a month-long reserved capacity pilot in place.

3) Proposed next steps
- Schedule an executive bridge (VP/CTO handshake) this week to unblock procurement.
- Share a short mutual action plan and draft SOW (attached) for your procurement and infra teams.
- Technical deep-dive/demo with Rishi and Marissa once execs align — 60 minutes, include infra/ops and one engineering use case.
